reviews.text: Allison and the Wagging Tails team are terrific!! Reliable, trustworthy and they love what they do. Maddy has been walking with Wagging Tails for the last 8 years. We are so incredibly happy with Wagging Tails!!
Lucy loves Scott and we’ve been super happy with the dog walking services that Wagging Tails provides. They’re friendly and accommodating when schedules change and we’re always grateful.

We’ve had a great experience working with Wagging Tails. Their team consistently demonstrates a strong commitment to health and safety, which is something we value highly and, quite honestly, is not always easy to find these days. Their team also holds valid Pet First Aid and CPR certification through a recognized professional training provider.

They’ve built a structured and reliable approach to group walks, ensuring dogs are well matched and cared for in a safe environment. It’s clear they take their responsibility seriously.

We share a similar standard when it comes to care and professionalism, and it is always reassuring to collaborate with a team that prioritizes safety and well-being at this level.

We confidently recommend Wagging Tails to pet parents looking for a dependable and safety-focused group walking service.

Just the best! We’ve been using Wagging Tails since 2019 and they are kind, warm, reliable, and professional. We have a small dog (less than 20 lbs) who goes for group walks twice per week and they generally match up dogs that will get along, and ours is always so excited to go on her walks. Really they’re just the best!
Allison is super professional, very reliable, and the absolute best! My dog loves her and she also takes the best group dog photos!
Our dog loves Monica and so do we. Really good with Leo and super helpful.

We wanted someone reliable to walk Luke and board him occasionally, either at our place or hers. Britt has been fantastic. Luke loves her, and so do we. And the one time I made a mistake and gave the wrong date for our absence, Allison stepped in to save the day. It's wonderful to have people we can rely on 100 per cent!

Our dog Penny has the best times with Scott, Allison and Brittany! They are the most reliable, caring and thoughtful dog-walkers we've ever had, and we've had only good ones. My friend who lives out of their zone is jealous we get to have them. Highly recommend!
1000% Recommend Wagging tails MTL ! Local business, dog lovers, I know my dog is having the best time during his walks !! Great communication and service !

I’ve been with the Wagging Tails team for over 8 years, and they’re absolutely the best! My dog is always cared for like he’s part of their family. Whether it’s pet sits or his daily walks—group or solo—it’s always the highlight of his day!

It's a fantastic team, with a special shout-out to Brittany...

Every day, Baltou has a wonderful time with his friends; he gets his exercise while socializing, and he's always happy to see his beloved Brittany come home the next day.

Pure bliss...💕

Wagging Tails has been wonderful. The dog walkers are kind, reliable, and clearly care a lot about the animals they work with. Jinger is always happy to see them, and that gives me real peace of mind. You receive an alert when they are picked up, with a photo, and then another alert when they are home and the route they walked. I love it. I’m very grateful for their help and fully recommend them.

Wagging Tails in Pointe-Saint-Charles are simply the best! My dog Nico, a very nervous and reactive 4-year-old Border Collie, isn’t always easy to handle—but the team truly understands him. They take the time to carefully match each dog’s temperament with the right walker and group, which has made such a difference for Nico.

I especially trust Allison, who has been incredible with him—patient, attentive, and clearly experienced with more sensitive dogs. It gives me real peace of mind knowing Nico is in such good hands. Highly recommend!
A warm welcome; you can tell the dogs are loved for who they are. My dog ​​is always so happy knowing he's going for a walk with Wagging Tails. Highly recommended.
Alison took care of our large breed dog Dezi when we were away for travel and she is the best! Dezi absolutely loves her!!

Wagging tails mtl is a team of amazing dog walkers. They are super organized and you can rely on them every day. I was super nervous to get a dog because I work long hours but wagging tails has taken care of my little puppy from a couple months old giving me piece of mind. While they walk your dog you can see if they peed or pooped and you often get a really cute pic of your smiling pup! They not only help with walks, but they babysit and will help you organize what’s best for you dog if you have to travel etc.. I am truly blessed that I found them. The entire team is so kind and they really really love dogs …and they have the best instagram!
Wagging tails are professional, trustworthy and caring dog walkers and pet sitters. Our dog loves her wagging tails family!

The absolute BEST. I can’t say enough good things about Wagging Tail Mtl! From day one, they’ve been reliable, professional, and an absolute joy to work with. Every interaction is warm and friendly—they truly go above and beyond to make both me and my pup feel comfortable and cared for.

What really sets them apart is how much they clearly love what they do. My dog lights up the moment they arrive (even more than when I arrive!), tail wagging like crazy, which says everything you need to know. It’s such a relief to have a team I can trust completely with my fur baby. They’re always on time, communicative, and super flexible with scheduling, which makes my life so much easier.

If you’re looking for a dog walking service that’s not only dependable, trustworthy and professional, but also genuinely lovely people—look no further. These folks are the real deal. Highly, highly recommend!

Our dog Tigger is obsessed with Scott, who walks her once or twice a week. We have also used their dog sitting services, where Tigger has stayed with them, multiple times - from a few days to a few weeks of time. We have been a customer for multiple years now and very happy with Wagging Tails team.

As a single dog mom who works hybrid, the Wagging Tails crew were crucial in my dog’s success for potty training while I was at work. They also supported many other things my dog was working on, leash socialization, learning going up and down steps, etc. My dog is also extremely social. On the days I work from home, I can tell he gets bored being stuck at home just with me. He loves being amongst his friends (human + canine). I love getting the check in and check out emails with status updates pf the walk. Overall, really dependable service and def recommend to anyone looking for a dog walker!
Would 100% recommend Wagging Tails; they are reliable, super kind and the only people I trust with my dog when I am not home for her midday walks! They genuinely care about your pets.

The best team of dog walkers in the Sud-Ouest, if not the whole of Montreal! I've known them for years and wouldn't trust anyone else with our pup. They're professional, caring and they love dogs! What more could you ask for?

Amazing service! Jerry loves going on walks with Alexis, he has a new buddy and at the end of each walk we get a map and a short review of his journey. We feel confident that Jerry is in good hands when we send him out on his walks :)

I can’t say enough great things about the team at Wagging Tails! I've been using their services since my dog, Nacho, was just 4 months old—he’s now 7. Over the years, I’ve relied on both their dog walking and pet sitting services, and they’ve consistently exceeded my expectations.

When I was working long hours, I always felt completely at ease knowing Nacho was in such caring hands. The team doesn’t just walk him—they check his water, make sure he’s comfortable, and genuinely care about his well-being. It’s the little thoughtful touches that mean so much.

Their app is also amazing! It shows photos of each visit, tracks the walk with a map, and even gives updates on whether he peed or pooped. It’s detailed, reliable, and adds so much peace of mind.

Allison and the entire team are truly stellar. Thank you for loving and caring for my baby like he’s your own. You guys are the best—I’m so grateful for you!
Patty & Nacho

Allison and the rest of the Wagging Tails team take such good care of our pup! Gus went through a stubborn teenage phase and Allison was so patient with us and Gus, taking him on solo walks until he was able to go back to his group walks with his pals. We feel so lucky that we found Wagging Tails and would recommend to anyone looking for a dog walker :)
Very reliable dog walkers that can accomodate last minute changes to your schedule which is super practical.  I really appreocate the flexibility they offer.

We love Wagging Tails so much! The whole team has been 100% reliable, trustworthy, & lovely to deal with. They've always come through when we've had health emergencies or other unexpected needs. We especially adore Britt, our delightful regular dog walker! Adventure Days are a great service & overnights are available. Cannot say enough good things about Wagging Tails. :)
The best dog walkers in the city! My dog have been walking with them for 2 years! Great service! Great price! Great people! We love it !
Súper flexible, caring and reliable! My pups love Scott and Monica and Allison 🙏🏻🐾 …

Wagging Tails has been our go-to since we adopted Hops in 2019. Hops can be quite stubborn and selective about who walks him, but he absolutely adores Britt! She’s dependable, hardworking, and incredibly trustworthy. I never have to worry when Hops is in her care.

With every walk, you receive an update, a photo, a map of the route, and pick-up and drop-off times.

I’ve recommended Wagging Tails to so many dog-parents!

Allison is an exceptional dog walker who has been a true blessing for our family. Her reliability, professionalism, and genuine love for animals shine through in every interaction. Our dog absolutely adores her, and we can always count on Allison to provide attentive care and plenty of exercise. She goes above and beyond, sharing multiple photos via the app that give us peace of mind while we’re away. We couldn’t ask for a better person to trust with our furry family member!

The best around. They were so great with my handicapped dog, walking him with the utmost care and choosing dogs to accompany him that were calm and gentle. 10/10 would keep using their services if I still lived in the area!
